summary: This resolution elects Ms. Chu to the House Budget Committee and ranks her immediately after Ms. Jayapal.

scores.thoughts: This resolution merely assigns a Democratic member to rank on the House Budget Committee. It contains no provisions that alter, authorize, or affect any government spending levels or appropriations.
The bill is a committee assignment resolution with no tax-related language or implications.
No healthcare policy content appears in the resolution.
The resolution addresses only internal House committee ranking and has zero connection to firearms policy.
